name: Chang Lan Electric Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chang Lan Electric Technology Co.,Ltd., a Chinese enterprise, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a wide array of cable accessories. Its offerings span both direct current (DC) and alternating current (AC) cable accessories, in addition to cold and heat-shrinkable types. Essential grounding devices and diverse cable fittings are also part of its product line. Beyond accessories, the firm furnishes a complete selection of installation and cable-laying instruments. This includes equipment such as cable burnishing machines, insulated operational tools, compression devices, JSD cable haulers, cable rollers, drum stands, and integrated cable winch and calibration units. Moreover, Chang Lan provides various supplementary materials for cable applications, including waterproof tapes, epoxy sealing muds, self-bonding fire-resistant tapes, self-adhesive rubber insulating tapes, wet-solidifying armored tapes, and insulated waterproof gasket cement. These products are crucial for numerous critical industries, such as power grids, power plants, renewable energy, railway and subway systems, and nuclear power. Established in 1958, the company maintains its headquarters in Changsha, China.
